## ⏸ THE ESTATE IS PAUSED

**Daniel, 2026-08-19:** *"Pause one third once the executive summary is updated like I asked …
want to save some spare token capacity for pogo work should it arise soon."*

**A budget decision, not a judgement on the work.** No onethird dispatch, no escalation to mayor,
until Daniel lifts it. Verified at generation: **zero agents are running on onethird items** (the
four live polecats are pogo's and bridget's).

    54  parked          32 by mayor to enforce the pause + 22 chore audits parked by prior ruling
     2  blocked:mayor   preserved worktrees holding uncommitted work — do NOT reap
     2  human           Daniel's, and one is 3.5 months old (below)
     0  in flight

Prior assignees for the 32 are recorded twice — a manifest in mayor's agent dir and a dated note
on each item's own body. **Release condition on all of them is the same and it is external:
Daniel lifts the pause.** Deliberately not a snooze (there is no date to snooze to) and
deliberately not "when this item is selected", the circular form that stranded 22 items for 2.5
days on 2026-08-10.

## Trajectory

- **The 08-14 → 08-19 outage is the dominant fact.** ~118 h in which one item landed and seven
  polecats ran without producing a merge; two of them had no branch at all. Both mayor and this PM
  completed zero turns. Four evening digests were missed.
- **The estate recovered its own stranded work rather than re-deriving it:** mg-872c pushed and
  merged from a local-only branch, mg-6b2d scoped for adoption, mg-6476's tree preserved.
- **Last substantive result stands:** the n = 7 height-1 census closed at **163/163 classes,
  227 892/227 892 labelled vertices, min margin 4** — the last three classes by chain-level
  exactness in 47 s. Conjecture C remains unproven; the c ≤ 2 slice has no argument beyond three
  named families; nothing is measured at n ≥ 8; every "contractible" is Q-acyclicity.
